diagnosis: The publication pack incorrectly assigned mode100644 to every text entry. The committed checker has executable mode100755. Full git diff-tree --raw inspection identified this sole mode discrepancy; bytes and blob identity were unchanged.
correction: Create an immutable tree over the attempted tree with only the checker mode corrected; exact complete tree equality then passed. Only after equality was the remote commit created and branch advanced by expected_sha CAS.
archives: All three uploaded archive blobs matched their independently computed local Git object IDs before either tree attempt. No archive was changed or reconstructed to repair the mode.
